At the 100 lowest-paying major corporations — including Walmart, DoorDash, and Amazon — CEO pay averaged $17.5M in 2025.

Median worker pay was just $36,571, a ratio of 614 to 1.

Those same 100 companies spent $108.6B on stock buybacks last year.

How can anyone defend this?
